description: Run a Sales Navigator search: resolve filters, run a multi-query plan through the Powerset API (set) or the user's own LinkedIn session (no set), ingest, enrich and resolve mutual URLs (cloud), export, optional scoring.

steps.when: user provides company names or human-readable titles instead of LinkedIn IDs

steps.description: Write search_plan.json (structured queries first, keywords last), run, read the per-query summaries in the output, and continue with a second plan file whose new ids add the queries the results call for. The pipeline ingests, enriches and resolves mutual URLs (cloud) and exports by itself.

steps.when: user asks a qualitative/refinement question over the current Sales Nav run
